description: This file defines an abstract class 'DefinedName' that manages named ranges and formulas within a spreadsheet. It includes methods for creation, validation, scope management, and resolution of named names used in spreadsheets.

classes.name: DefinedName
classes.description: An abstract class representing named ranges or formulas in a spreadsheet, providing mechanisms for creation, validation, and scope management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor to initialize a defined name with its properties.

methods.name: createInstance
methods.description: Factory method to create either a NamedRange or NamedFormula instance based on the value.

methods.name: testIfFormula
methods.description: Static method to determine if a given value represents a formula.

methods.name: getName
methods.description: Returns the name of the defined name.

methods.name: setName
methods.description: Sets a new name for the defined name and updates references.

methods.name: getWorksheet
methods.description: Returns the worksheet associated with this defined name.

methods.name: setWorksheet
methods.description: Assigns a worksheet to this defined name.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the value (range or formula) of the defined name.

methods.name: setValue
methods.description: Sets a new value for the defined name.

methods.name: getLocalOnly
methods.description: Returns whether the defined name is local to a worksheet.

methods.name: setLocalOnly
methods.description: Sets whether the defined name is local to the worksheet.

methods.name: getScope
methods.description: Returns the scope worksheet of the defined name.

methods.name: setScope
methods.description: Sets the scope worksheet of the defined name.

methods.name: isFormula
methods.description: Checks if the defined name represents a formula.

methods.name: resolveName
methods.description: Static method to resolve a named range to its corresponding object, given a worksheet and optional sheet name.

methods.name: __clone
methods.description: Deep cloning method for the DefinedName object.
